motivation: The frozen K5/r=1 km external confirmation failed portability and applicability; fixed site count does not represent a comparable design footprint across island domains. This experiment changes only the operational budget representation on a new development cohort.

retained_components.ecological_support: q=0.10 NDVI-state nearest-prototype eligibility from the frozen method; no q retuning
retained_components.selector: exact sparse greedy maximum newly covered land-grid cells

budget.object: coverage-equivalent design footprint, not biological suitability and not literal searched area
budget.stopping_rule: for each method and target, take the shortest greedy prefix whose union of design-radius land-grid neighborhoods reaches the target fraction; if target is unreachable within max_sites the cell is infeasible
budget.primary_curve_summary: paired trapezoidal area under recall-versus-target-coverage curve over the four predeclared targets

deployment_information_adequacy.domain_gate: research/acsp_training_domain_gate.py on all available training records

development_estimands.primary: taxon-island paired AUC lift of q10 over q1 across equal coverage-equivalent budgets
secondary: recall lift at every target coverage fraction
site count needed by each method at each target

decision.if_q10_auc_stably_positive: retain ecological eligibility as a low-footprint modifier and proceed to route/time-cost development on a separate new development cohort or strict split
decision.if_q10_auc_not_stably_positive: drop q10 ecological eligibility from the transferable operational method and retain geometry-only coverage as the portable core

hard_boundaries: Do not use the inspected 24-pair cross-island confirmation cohort for tuning or evaluation.
Do not consume the frozen 192-pair Practical Core cohort.
Do not change q, NDVI features, thinning, or domain-gate thresholds in this experiment.
Do not interpret design-radius coverage as literal field searched area or detection probability.
Negative results remain in the component ledger.
